title: Sleepy hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body / spines as a big rounded mound -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='36' ry='26' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- individual spines: lighter brown tufts -->
  <g fill='#c98a4b'>
    <path d='M20 56 q4 -14 12 -10 q-4 8 -2 14 z'/>
    <path d='M30 44 q6 -16 14 -11 q-5 8 -4 15 z'/>
    <path d='M43 40 q6 -16 14 -10 q-7 7 -6 15 z'/>
    <path d='M56 39 q7 -15 14 -8 q-7 6 -6 15 z'/>
    <path d='M68 44 q8 -12 12 -4 q-6 5 -5 13 z'/>
    <path d='M78 54 q8 -8 9 0 q-4 4 -3 10 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spine tips in cream for texture -->
  <g fill='#f0d6a8'>
    <circle cx='27' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='43' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='81' cy='55' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face: soft lighter muzzle, at left front -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='70' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#e6b877'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='76' r='6' fill='#f4a6a0'/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eye: curved lit line -->
  <path d='M20 66 q5 5 10 0' stroke='#3b2a1a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little nose -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='72' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- tiny smile -->
  <path d='M14 78 q5 3 9 -1' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#e6b877'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- little front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e6b877'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='87' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e6b877'/>
  <!-- Zzz above, sleepy -->
  <g stroke='#bfe3ff' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <path d='M66 22 h9 l-9 10 h9'/>
    <path d='M78 12 h6 l-6 7 h6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
